```python
import narwhals as nw

# Create sample DataFrame
df = nw.from_dict({
    "id": [1, 2, 3],
    "jan": [100, 200, 300],
    "feb": [150, 250, 350],
    "mar": [120, 220, 320]
})

# Reshape from wide to long format
df_long = df.melt(
    id_vars=["id"],
    value_vars=["jan", "feb", "mar"],
    variable_name="month",
    value_name="sales"
)

print(df_long)
```
